description:
DNS record lookup for a domain and record type

Returns DNS records of the specified type for a domain.

Supported types: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, PTR, SRV, ALL (default).

Results are cached for 5 minutes.

Cost: 1 credit(s) per call. An API key is required via the X-Api-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer <key>); a per-call wallet payment via x402 is also accepted.
name: lookup.dns.records
